title: Sutte Hakkun '98: Winter Event Version - Stage 2 (Winter Lake)
description:
The cold snow background seen in the special winter edition of Sutte Hakkun. Compared to the old version, this one has better palette management and it is much more complete, covering the entire background space. A good fit for snowy lakes, in general.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
